listeningQuestions.audio: Much of the value of AI lies in its capacity to analyse data.
opts: AI 的价值大多在于它分析数据的能力。
AI 无法分析任何东西。

listeningQuestions.audio: Almost 50 per cent of US jobs are at risk from automation.
opts: 近一半的美国工作面临自动化的风险。

listeningQuestions.audio: We have no choice but to embrace AI and regulate it.
opts: 我们应当彻底禁止 AI。
我们应当完全忽视 AI。
我们别无选择,只能接纳并管理 AI。

listeningQuestions.audio: None of us is fully prepared for the challenges of AI.
opts: 我们都已为 AI 做好准备。
我们没有谁为 AI 的挑战做好充分准备。

listeningQuestions.audio: A self-driving car can make judgements based on information.
opts: 自动驾驶汽车能根据信息作出判断。
自动驾驶汽车从不收集信息。
自动驾驶汽车只会停在原地。
自动驾驶汽车需要司机帮忙。

listeningQuestions.audio: AI is not magic, and it is not something to fear.
opts: AI 不是魔法,也不必害怕。

quizQuestions.q: Much of the value of AI lies in its ____ to analyse data.（能力）
Taxi drivers may be among the first ____ of automation.（受害者）
We have no choice but to embrace AI and ____ it.（管理）
AI doctors are on the ____, even if they are not here yet.（即将到来）
Almost 50 per cent of US jobs ____ at risk from automation.
None of us ____ fully prepared for the challenges of AI.
Neither the cars nor the robot ____ truly alive.
There ____ a few machine-learning problems when the first cars arrive.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 不止一位专家警告过我们人工智能的风险。
没有专家担心人工智能。
人工智能没有任何风险。
quizQuestions.audio: More than one expert has warned us about the risks of AI.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 面临风险的工作数量保持不变。
面临风险的工作数量逐年上升。
quizQuestions.audio: The number of jobs at risk is rising every year.

reading.passage: AI is no longer science fiction; it is already part of daily life. Used wisely, it can help us a great deal, but a person, not a machine, is always responsible for how it is used.
reading.passageCn: 人工智能不再是科幻;它已是日常生活的一部分。善加利用,它能给我们很大帮助,但对它如何被使用负责的,永远是人,而非机器。

questions.q: Who is always responsible for how AI is used?
When can AI help us a great deal?

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph giving your opinion on the question "Is AI a real threat?" State your view, give one reason with an example, and end with a balanced conclusion. Pay attention to subject-verb agreement.
writing.promptCn: 就"AI 是真正的威胁吗?"写一小段,亮明观点、给一条理由并举例,最后给出平衡的结论。注意主谓一致(分数/百分比、none、there be)。

lines.text: Do you think machines will really take our jobs?
lines.cn: 你觉得机器真的会抢走我们的工作吗?

lines.text: Some jobs, maybe. Almost half of them are at risk one day.
lines.cn: 也许会有一些。某些工作有朝一日近一半都面临风险。

lines.text: That sounds frightening. What can we do about it?
lines.cn: 听起来挺吓人的。我们能做些什么呢?

lines.text: Keep learning new skills, so we stay useful beside the machines.
lines.cn: 不断学习新技能,这样我们就能在机器旁边继续发挥作用。

lines.text: Could a robot ever be a real friend, do you think?
lines.cn: 你觉得机器人能成为真正的朋友吗?

lines.text: Maybe friendship is more about feelings than about metal.
lines.cn: 也许友谊更多关乎感情,而不是金属。

lines.text: But a machine only acts as though it cares.
lines.cn: 可机器只是装作在乎罢了。

lines.text: True. In the end, a person decides what really matters.
lines.cn: 没错。归根结底,是人来决定什么才真正重要。
